topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I just got this package, and it’s not even mine—it's got the old tenant's name on it. I've barely had time to settle in, and now this. I don't need more chaos, but here we are. I tried calling the delivery guy, but of course, no answer. I guess I have to figure out how to get this back to the right person or at least redirect it. I can't just leave it; that feels wrong. But I’ve got my own stuff to deal with, deadlines looming, and this is just a huge distraction. I hope the previous tenant is easy to reach, or I might just lose it.
